name: 28348 · Hope Mills, NC
findings: ZIP 28348 (Hope Mills) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28348 (Hope Mills) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28348 (Hope Mills) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
